SELECT 
    ea.enforcereg AS record_id,
    ea.compref2 AS compliance_case_id,
    id.behansc,
    id.netansc,
    ROUND(CAST((0.6 * id.behansc + 0.4 * id.netansc) AS numeric), 2) AS iii
FROM enforcementactions ea
JOIN investigationdetails id ON ea.invdetref = id.invdetreg
WHERE ea.resstat != 'Resolved'
  AND (0.6 * id.behansc + 0.4 * id.netansc) > 75
ORDER BY iii DESC;
